# möbius for macOS 0.3.3

- Messages from another Bot appear as left-aligned transcript messages with a border and sender attribution. Opening messages stay visible before the work summary; messages received during active work fold into that summary.
- New chats show the original Bot picker directly below the folder choice. Messages from a Bot’s persistent conversation show its name without an extra session title; project-chat sender titles remain available.
- Appearance settings offer a color picker, editable HEX value and reset for the current theme, preserving your light and dark choices.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later, and gateway 0.16.2 (protocol 87).
